prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal]
Set `fast-coder` context window to `262144` across OpenCode, Codex, and Claude Code permanently while preserving all other model settings.

[action]
- Inspected [README.md](<WORKSPACE>/README.md), [models.json](<WORKSPACE>/models.json), [gen.py](<WORKSPACE>/gen.py), and the generated files in `out/`.
- Found that [out/opencode.json](<WORKSPACE>/out/opencode.json) had been hand-edited to `262144`, while the source of truth [models.json](<WORKSPACE>/models.json#L3) still had `"context_window": 131072` (which [out/codex.toml](<WORKSPACE>/out/codex.toml) and [out/claude.json](<WORKSPACE>/out/claude.json) reflected).
- Assumptions & decisions on open points: "for good" requires updating the source of truth ([models.json](<WORKSPACE>/models.json)) so future runs of [`main`](<WORKSPACE>/gen.py#L48-L54) in [gen.py](<WORKSPACE>/gen.py) do not revert `out/` back to `131072`, and immediately running `python gen.py` so the generated artifacts in `out/` also match.
- Updated `fast-coder`'s `context_window` to `262144` in [models.json](<WORKSPACE>/models.json#L3) and ran `python gen.py`.

[result]
What I found and how I know it is right:
- [models.json](<WORKSPACE>/models.json) is the single source of truth used by [gen.py](<WORKSPACE>/gen.py) to generate [out/opencode.json](<WORKSPACE>/out/opencode.json), [out/codex.toml](<WORKSPACE>/out/codex.toml), and [out/claude.json](<WORKSPACE>/out/claude.json).
- Running `python gen.py` produced:
```text
wrote out/opencode.json
wrote out/codex.toml
wrote out/claude.json
```
- Verified exact file contents after regeneration:
